personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A branch hint in the one query every kart reads, and a direction of travel in every step, are the deep changes where a regression hides; the design at least promises that without a hint and on road everything answers what it answers today.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: A second circuit is more arcade, which I see as a gimmick, and this time it brings a migration with it; the migration only adds a board and rewrites no row.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: A whole new circuit from one line, with its own scenery, its own times and a cabinet that shows both: exactly the kind of feature I want shipped fast.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: The engine, a Supabase migration and MULTI's protocol in one PRD are three different reviews at once; I want them apart.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: It answers the person who asked, down to the cabinet they pointed at; it is a big one rather than a quick win, but every part of it is something a player sees.

objection.text: Je regarde le board pour garder la cohérence entre les équipes. Un seul PRD qui touche le moteur du kart, une migration Supabase et le protocole MULTI, ça fait trois choses de nature différente à relire d'un coup.

personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: The spec pins the two deep changes with tests that must pass unchanged: locate without a hint over a grid of COMET RING's points, and every kart test of today with the direction of travel added.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: Still a game feature to me; the migration is additive, has its check in supabase/checks and a rollback written down.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: Every waypoint, radius, surface factor and screen line is a number or a string a slice can build against, so it can go to the agents without another question.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: The objection is in the Decisions: the branch and the surfaces, the migration and MULTI each land in a slice of their own before the circuit, so each review is one kind of change.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: The acceptance criteria read as what a player and the crew will see, the cabinet's turns included, which is what the person asked for.
